Record Class EyeColor

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.eye.state.EyeColor
public record EyeColor(float r, float g, float b) extends Record
One RGB color, each channel 0..1. The single color representation across the mod — config, item/entity override, and the renderer all use this.

Serialized as a [r, g, b] list, the datapack JSON's color layout. Both codecs reject a channel outside 0..1 on decode, so every decoded color is in range.
